svg.text: B-T-S pipeline — Brain-to-Text '25 (v6.4): intracortical neural activity → phonemes → words
① ACOUSTIC MODEL — two cross-fit folds, one per Kaggle T4 (~10.7 h each)
one (session, block) of val, in trial order
Fold C: seen by neither model
Every val trial is decoded only by
the model(s) that never saw it —
C by both, exactly like test.
B2TNetV4 — Patch-Conv · BiGRU · Conformer, CTC (30.15 M params)
Loss = CTC + 0.3 · inter-CTC + 0.2 · CR-CTC (consistency between two augmented views)
Augment: speed ×0.9–1.1, white noise, offsets, gain, electrode dropout, time masking
AdamW 7e-4, time-based cosine to the session deadline · EMA 0.999 · day dropout 0.15
Continue-trained from the previous run; memory guard + resume keeps 11 h runs alive
by real beam WER on its
② DECODING — per trial (val: out-of-fold models only · test: both models)
emissions of every model that never trained on the trial
am = mean over models of log P_CTC(W | x)
top 8 hyps: swap one word for a lexicon
f = LLM log-prob/token of the s₁-best hyp
f ≥ τ: s = am + 2.5 ng + 1.6 llm − 0.5 nw
f < τ: s = am + 0.5 ng + 0.9 llm − 4.0 nw
(weights on A∪B, gate checked on C, refit)
near-tie trials; re-scored with am + ng
4.4 % of test trials in the f < τ regime
every weight is chosen on out-of-fold folds A∪B (1 142 trials) · verified once on fold C (284 trials, seen by no model and no tuner) · refit on A∪B∪C for the test submission.
greedy 44.63 % → flashlight 1-best 5.96 % → pool rescoring 4.62 % → + expansion 3.49 % → + adapted LLM 3.38 % → + fluency gate 3.38 %
